scholarships.title: Starr International Foundation Scholarship (University of St.Gallen)

existing.description: The Starr International Foundation promotes education in Switzerland and abroad, and the HSG Starr International Foundation Fund supports excellence scholarships of the HSG Best Talents Programme. The Best Talents Programme gives financial support, including coverage of tuition fees and contributions to living expenses, alongside a personal development programme for outstanding and engaged bachelor's graduates from EU/EFTA countries or holders of a Swiss C permit who are admitted to a master's at HSG. Applications for the 2026 cohort closed on 12 June 2026 and the portal reopens in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort.
eligibility: EU/EFTA national or holder of a Swiss C permit
Admitted to a Master's programme at the University of St.Gallen
A proven sense of responsibility towards society, the economy and the environment, and a diversity of perspectives
existing.eligibility_summary: Bachelor's graduates from EU/EFTA countries or holders of a Swiss C permit who are admitted to a Master's programme at HSG, with excellent grades, demonstrated engagement beyond their studies, a proven sense of responsibility and a diversity of perspectives.
benefits: Personal development programme alongside the studies
Access to the HSG community of lecturers, alumni and partner organisations
coverage: Through the Best Talents Programme: coverage of tuition fees and contributions to living expenses
No separate CHF amount is published for the Starr-funded awards
existing.notes: Material restructuring detected. The stored dedicated page for this award is dead (HTTP 404) and the HSG funds-and-excellence-scholarships page no longer carries a Starr section; the surviving official statement is the donors page, which routes the Starr fund into the HSG Best Talents Programme. The previously published Starr terms - English-language master's programmes only, holders of a recognised foreign bachelor's degree, and grants of CHF 20,000 per programme - are no longer present on any live official page I could fetch, so none of them are asserted here. Because the eligibility has moved from foreign-degree holders to EU/EFTA nationals and Swiss C-permit holders, this row now substantially overlaps the HSG Best Talents Programme; a human should decide whether to keep it separate or merge. No CHF figure is reported because none is published.
existing.application_period: Annual cohort cycle. The 2026 cohort window closed on June 12, 2026; the portal reopens in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2026 Best Talents cohort were accepted until June 12, 2026. The application portal will reopen in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort application cycle.
existing.program_type: Foundation-funded master's excellence scholarship, delivered through the HSG Best Talents Programme
